title: Choose the Tense II: Past
ringkas: Latihan kontras past simple, continuous, perfect, dan perfect continuous
goals: memilih tense yang tepat dari **tense masa lampau**: past simple, continuous, perfect, perfect continuous
membedakan **past simple** dari **present perfect** di cerita
menyusun **urutan kejadian** dengan tense yang konsisten
mengecek diri dengan **latihan campuran** masa lampau

lesson.text: Sekarang latihan kontras untuk masa lampau. Tiga pertanyaan penuntun: (1) apakah **waktunya disebut**? (2) apakah kejadiannya **selesai atau sedang berlangsung**? (3) apakah ada kejadian lain yang **lebih dulu**?

lesson.title: 1. Peta keputusan masa lampau
table: sedang berlangsung pada satu saat lampau
terjadi lebih dulu daripada kejadian lampau lain
[[I had been waiting for an hour when she came.]]

lesson.title: 2. Past perfect continuous
table: [[I had been waiting for an hour.]]

examples.en: [[She was tired because she had been working all day.]]
examples.id: Dia lelah karena sudah bekerja sepanjang hari.

lesson.title: Past simple atau present perfect?
lesson.text: Dalam cerita masa lalu yang waktunya jelas, pakai past simple. Present perfect hanya untuk hubungan dengan sekarang. Jangan campur: bukan ~~Yesterday I have gone~~.

practice.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar: "I ___ her yesterday."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "I ___ home when it began to rain."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "When I arrived, she ___ already left."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "She was tired because she ___ working all day."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "I ___ for an hour when she finally came."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "It was dark. The rain ___ hard."
practice.exp: Latar. Kalimat lengkap: **It was dark. The rain was falling hard.**

practice.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar: "Suddenly, a man ___ on the door."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "He was wet because he ___ in the rain."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "___ you been waiting long when the bus came?"
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "I ___ the film before, so I didn't go."
practice.exp: Lebih dulu. Kalimat lengkap: **I had seen the film before, so I didn't go.**

quiz.q: Pilih bentuk yang benar: "He ___ the door and walked in."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "At nine last night, we ___ dinner."
Pilih bentuk yang benar: "By the time we arrived, they ___ gone."
quiz.exp: had + V3. Kalimat lengkap: **By the time we arrived, they had gone.**

read.id:
Rina: Apakah kamu mendengar kebisingan tadi malam?
Dewi: Ya! Aku sedang tidur ketika mendengarnya.
Rina: Aku sudah membaca selama satu jam ketika lampu padam.
Dewi: Apa yang kamu lakukan?
Rina: Aku mengambil senter dan keluar. Seekor kucing telah menjatuhkan tempat sampah!
Dewi: Aku tidak takut karena aku pernah mendengar suara itu sebelumnya.

qs.exp: Rina: "A cat had knocked over the trash cans!".
qs.q: What had knocked over the trash cans?

options: I was sleeping when I had heard it.
I was sleeping when I heard it.
I had been reading for an hour.
A cat had knocked over the trash cans.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ when I heard it."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan had been reading atau read:
qs.q: I ___ for an hour when the lights went out.
A cat ___ knocked over the trash cans.

qs.answer: I took a flashlight and went outside.
qs.exp: Urutan: I took a flashlight and went outside.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku mengambil senter dan keluar."

read.text:
Rina: Did you hear the noise last night?
Dewi: Yes! I was sleeping when I heard it.
Rina: I had been reading for an hour when the lights went out.
Dewi: What did you do?
Rina: I took a flashlight and went outside. A cat had knocked over the trash cans!
Dewi: I wasn't afraid because I had heard that sound before.
read.title: A Strange Night

read.id: Kemarin sore, aku sedang berjalan ke sekolah ketika melihat sebuah dompet di jalan. Aku mengambilnya dan melihat ke dalamnya. Seseorang telah meninggalkan kartu identitas dan sejumlah uang. Sementara aku memikirkan apa yang harus dilakukan, seorang pria berlari ke arahku. Dia telah mencarinya selama satu jam. Aku mengembalikannya, dan dia berterima kasih berkali-kali.

qs.exp: Teks: "He had been looking for it for an hour".
qs.q: How long had the man been looking for the wallet?

options: I was walking to school when I had noticed a wallet.
I was walking to school when I noticed a wallet.
Someone had left an ID card.
He had been looking for it for an hour.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ to school when I noticed a wallet."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan had been atau has been:
qs.q: He ___ looking for it for an hour.

qs.answer: I picked it up and looked inside.
qs.exp: Urutan: I picked it up and looked inside.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku mengambilnya dan melihat ke dalamnya."

read.text: Yesterday afternoon, I was walking to school when I noticed a wallet on the road. I picked it up and looked inside. Someone had left an ID card and some money. While I was thinking about what to do, a man ran toward me. He had been looking for it for an hour. I gave it back, and he thanked me many times.
read.title: The Lost Wallet

Detective: Kapan Anda menyadari jendela terbuka?
Maid: Ketika saya masuk pukul delapan. Seseorang telah membukanya sebelum saya tiba.
Detective: Apa yang sedang Anda lakukan ketika mendengar suara itu?
Maid: Saya sedang membersihkan dapur. Saya sudah bekerja selama satu jam.
Detective: Apakah Anda melihat seseorang?
Maid: Tidak, tetapi pintu depan sudah tidak terkunci.

qs.q: What was the maid doing when she heard the noise?

options: Someone has opened it before I arrived.
Someone had opened it before I arrived.
I had been working for an hour.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ the kitchen when I heard the noise."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan had been atau have been:

qs.exp: Urutan: I came in at eight.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Saya masuk pukul delapan."

read.text:
Detective: When did you notice the window was open?
Maid: When I came in at eight. Someone had opened it before I arrived.
Detective: What were you doing when you heard the noise?
Maid: I was cleaning the kitchen. I had been working for an hour.
Detective: Did you see anyone?
Maid: No, but the front door had been unlocked.
read.title: The Detective's Questions
